name: 283. Anthropic web search on chat completions stays server-side and cites its sources (anthropic web search chat)
description: Pins upstream 1d3846bb1 (#7656) on the hosts whose web search reaches the Anthropic chat converter: Anthropic and Vertex. With the web_search server tool on /v1/chat/completions, the search runs on Anthropic's side: the streamed server_tool_use input (input_json_delta) used to leave as an orphan tool_calls delta with no id or name, which OpenAI clients treat as a real tool call, and text-block web_search_result_location citations were dropped. Now no tool_calls delta or tool_calls finish appears, and citations become message.annotations[].url_citation (non-streamed) or delta.annotations on the cited block's stop (streamed), spanning byte offsets of the content string. Red before the change: the stream carried a tool_calls delta and neither form carried annotations. /anthropic/v1/messages is a passthrough and /v1/responses has its own web search mapping, so neither changes. Bedrock is not reached: web_search_20250305 does not select InvokeModel (toolNeedsAnthropicInvokePath only does for tool_search and deferred tools), and Converse drops web search tools for Claude, so a Bedrock case could not exercise this converter. Run with FEATURE="anthropic web search chat".
